xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4723: Flaky create-workspace-row test turned main red: an unmocked git call fails in the non-git temp dir

plan.title: Flaky create-workspace-row test turned main red: an unmocked git call fails in the non-git temp dir
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.docsJustification: Test-only fix: no CLI, config, route, or user/developer doc describes these test files or their mocks. The testing hazard is recorded in the codebase map (.overdeck/context/codebase/conventions.md, Testing) by the planning session.

narratives.Problem: main CI went red (run 41317624589 attempt 1): create-workspace-row.test.ts failed 9 of 10 tests. The issue blamed an unmocked git call; the log shows every failure was 'Only 9.3 GiB free on the filesystem holding /tmp/pan-1990-create-row-…'. createWorkspace() calls checkDiskFloor(projectConfig.path) at src/lib/workspace-manager/create.ts:202, which reads real free space with statfs (node:fs/promises). The tests mock util.promisify (all git/npm/docker) but not statfs, so they fail whenever the runner's /tmp has under 10 GiB free. Runner free disk varies near 10 GiB, hence intermittent. Reproduced locally with TMPDIR on a 6.3 GiB tmpfs: create-workspace-row 9 failed, create-resume-setup 4 failed, tests/lib/workspace-manager.test.ts 1 failed. The 'git branch --show-current' log line comes from handoff-context.ts:166 during the unrelated, passing continue-readers-plan-home.test.ts.
narratives.Proposal: Mock src/lib/disk-floor.js (checkDiskFloor -> hoisted vi.fn resolving null) in the three test files that run the real createWorkspace, and add one regression test in create-workspace-row.test.ts proving the disk-floor refusal returns success=false, creates no row, and runs no subprocess. No production code change.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing checkDiskFloor, the 10 GiB floor, or any file under src/
- Silencing the 'Error capturing git state' log in handoff-context.ts or its test
- Changing the CI workflow or freeing runner disk space
- Adding skip, skipIf, .only, retry, or timeout changes to any test
- Mocking the disk floor in test files that never run the real createWorkspace

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the tests, not create.ts or disk-floor.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: The disk floor correctly guards real project paths against ENOSPC (PAN-1674); the defect is unit tests that mock every subprocess but let one real filesystem probe through. The issue allows 'fix the test or the code, whichever is wrong'.

autoDecisions.summary: Mock checkDiskFloor via vi.mock of disk-floor.js with importOriginal, not statfs or readAvailableBytes
autoDecisions.rationale: checkDiskFloor's default reader is bound inside disk-floor.ts, so mocking the exported readAvailableBytes would not take effect; mocking node:fs/promises statfs would be broader than needed.

autoDecisions.summary: Extend scope from the one named file to all three files with the same exposure
autoDecisions.rationale: The low-disk repro fails create-resume-setup.test.ts and tests/lib/workspace-manager.test.ts the same way; fixing only one would leave main exposed to the identical flake. 21 transitive-caller files passed under the repro, so the set is exactly three.

autoDecisions.summary: Add one disk-floor refusal regression test in create-workspace-row.test.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: Once mocked, createWorkspace's disk-floor gate has no test; a deterministic refusal test covers it and proves the mock is wired.

autoDecisions.summary: Use a docsJustification instead of a docs item
autoDecisions.rationale: No documented surface describes these tests; the hazard goes in the codebase map conventions.md written by planning.

items.title: Mock checkDiskFloor in create-workspace-row.test.ts and add a disk-floor refusal test

verify_commands: for i in $(seq 1 50); do npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/workspace-manager/create-workspace-row.test.ts || exit 1; done
expected_outputs: the new disk-floor refusal test passes

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4723.md). In tests/unit/lib/workspace-manager/create-workspace-row.test.ts: (1) extend the vi.hoisted block at line 7 to also return `mockCheckDiskFloor: vi.fn()`; (2) after the `vi.mock('util', ...)` block (lines 16-19) add `vi.mock('../../../../src/lib/disk-floor.js', async (importOriginal) => ({ ...(await importOriginal<typeof import('../../../../src/lib/disk-floor.js')>()), checkDiskFloor: mockCheckDiskFloor }))` with a one-line comment citing PAN-4723 and the statfs read; (3) in beforeEach (line 35) add `mockCheckDiskFloor.mockReset(); mockCheckDiskFloor.mockResolvedValue(null);`; (4) in the first test ('creates a kind=issue row via the writer…') add `expect(mockCheckDiskFloor).toHaveBeenCalledWith(tempDir);` after the existing success assertion, proving the real statfs check is replaced; (5) add the test 'refuses before creating the row or running git when the disk floor refuses (PAN-4723)' exactly as in the PRD WI-1 step 4. Root cause for the PR description: create.ts:202 `checkDiskFloor(projectConfig.path)` reads real free space via statfs (node:fs/promises, not covered by the promisify mock); CI runner /tmp had 9.3 GiB < 10 GiB floor (run 41317624589 attempt 1: 9/10 tests failed with 'Only 9.3 GiB free'); intermittent because runner free disk varies around 10 GiB; the 'Error capturing git state' line is handoff-context.ts:166 logging from the unrelated passing continue-readers-plan-home.test.ts. Do not touch src/. No skip/skipIf/.only/retry.

items.title: Given checkDiskFloor is replaced by the hoisted mockCheckDiskFloor (resolving null in beforeEach), when `npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/workspace-manager/create-workspace-row.test.ts` runs, then it exits 0 with 11 passed and 0 failed, and the first test asserts mockCheckDiskFloor was called with tempDir

Given mockCheckDiskFloor resolves an 'Only 1.0 GiB free' string, when createWorkspace runs for pan-4723, then it returns success=false with that message, getWorkspaceForIssue('PAN-4723') returns null, and mockExecAsync records zero calls
The issue's 50-iteration loop over tests/unit/lib/workspace-manager/create-workspace-row.test.ts exits 0 with no failing run

The PR description contains the name of checkDiskFloor's statfs read at src/lib/workspace-manager/create.ts:202 as the unmocked call, contains runner free disk near 10 GiB as the intermittency cause, and attributes the git branch --show-current log line to continue-readers-plan-home.test.ts
